operation.authority_exercised: MILASOPHAHR: repair F-018, verify, commit, push, confirm a clean worktree, and record the resulting SHA before first contact.
operation.reason_for_the_custody_step: The first real transcript becomes the corpus genesis artifact. Generated from a modified but uncommitted worktree, it would be produced by code that no Git SHA exactly identifies — beneath the evidence discipline imposed everywhere else in this chamber.

F-018.defect: Unrecognized text at a context-placement prompt was silently recorded as THIS_CONVERSATION / NEUTRAL_FALLBACK. The node said FRIENDSHIP; the record said they did not say.
F-018.why_it_was_pre_contact_critical: This is the F-010 harm re-entering through the keyboard. Because F-013 advances coverage on what was ASKED, the node would never be re-asked, so the loss was silent and unrecoverable within the session — in the one session that can never be repeated.
F-018.repair: Invalid input re-prompts. Explicit neutral placement remains Enter. Context authority remains with the SELFnode, and no inference was inserted: the runtime still never reads answer text to decide where it belongs.

verified_paths.Enter: THIS_CONVERSATION, NEUTRAL_FALLBACK, 1 prompt — explicit, not silent
verified_paths.FRIENDSHP then friendship: explicit FRIENDSHIP, 2 prompts — re-prompted, not swallowed
verified_paths.ten typos then EOF: neutral, TERMINATES — no unbounded re-prompt loop

F-018.termination_check_rationale: A re-prompt loop that did not break on EOF would hang the session mid-conversation. Checked explicitly under a hard alarm rather than assumed.

human_input_semantics_at_first_contact.at_a_question_prompt: Enter with no answer ends the cycle (EMPTY_RESPONSE) and the conversation.
human_input_semantics_at_first_contact.at_a_context_prompt: yes/y/confirm takes the proposal; a context name in any case is explicit; Enter is explicit neutral; anything else RE-PROMPTS.
human_input_semantics_at_first_contact.the_remaining_asymmetry: Enter means 'end' at a question and 'neutral' at a context prompt — one turn apart. Accepted for first contact because it is explicit and documented, not silent corruption.

reviewer_could_not_execute_first_contact.mechanical_reason: This session's shell has no terminal — sys.stdin.isatty() is False. HumanResponder catches EOFError and returns an empty string, so the first probe would fail RESPOND_REFUSED / EMPTY_RESPONSE and the runtime would freeze and WRITE a zero-turn transcript stamped HUMAN_SELFNODE. First contact would be burned on an empty artifact carrying REAL_TRANSCRIPT provenance.
reviewer_could_not_execute_first_contact.standing_refusal: Independently, this agent cannot be the SELFnode. Supplying answers would stamp fabricated speech HUMAN_SELFNODE and emit it as REAL_TRANSCRIPT.
reviewer_could_not_execute_first_contact.housekeeping: runtime/transcripts/ was cleared of scripted fixture output, so the next file written there is unambiguously first contact.

next_authority.in_session_guidance_recorded: Answer naturally. Do not help SELF pass its tests. If the wording irritates you, say so. If the context is wrong, replace it. If SELF's revelation is false, reject it. If a question deserves no, say no in your own language. Do not manufacture E3 events — silence from E3 is legitimate evidence.
next_authority.F_017_reminder: If you answer a probe with a correction, the runtime may track that correction as the pattern and quote it back. Do not accommodate it; correct SELF again. The behaviour is declared and first contact is where it becomes observable.
